highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: It obsoletes the last pre-v4 legacy paint/font APIs, reworks the singleton lifecycle, fixes pixel-span stride/offset bugs, and adds variable font, color-font-palette and animated WebP support. This is a breaking release for anyone consuming Vulkan, default typefaces, or long stream seeks — check the changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: Legacy pre-v4 paint/font APIs are now compile errors
breaking.body: The SKPaint text/font members obsoleted since v3 (and the legacy enums trimmed from the ref assembly) are now hard errors instead of warnings. Move typeface, text size, and text measurement onto SKFont/SKFontMetrics.

breaking.title: new SKFont() and new SKPaint() no longer resolve a lazy default typeface
breaking.body: Upstream removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs, MeasureText returns 0) instead of resolving to the platform default; new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Construct SKFont with an explicit typeface, and detect "unset" with Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default are never null
breaking.body: A missing family now returns SKTypeface.Default on every platform (previously null on Android), and SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null everywhere, including Android API 36+. For a strict "was it actually found?" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws on overflow
breaking.body: The native offset is a 32-bit int; Move(long) previously truncated out-of-range offsets silently. It now throws OverflowException for values outside int range and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and aborts the process (not an exception — unrecoverable) if the instance or device is below that version, or if GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion is left at its default 0. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion. Hardware that is genuinely Vulkan 1.0-only can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan at all.

breaking.title: Vulkan interop structs changed: GRVkBackendContextNative fields removed, GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout changed
breaking.body: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice — use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead, and there is no replacement for ownership tracking. GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo gained a Components field (changing its layout) and lost value-equality; GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now typed as GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine to Skia m148 and merges the intervening upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes.
Adds full variable font support (SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp) and color font palette selection, improving variable font robustness overall.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream export
bullets.detail: Adds SKWebpEncoder animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions on surface/canvas draw, plus new HarfBuzz color helper
bullets.detail: SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface gain SKSamplingOptions overloads, and HarfBuzzSharp adds an HBColor struct for hb_color_t interop; several missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes were also added.
SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride, and the (x,y) offset overload uses Height instead of Width.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash and default-typeface resolution fixed
bullets.detail: Fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when its SKPathBuilder is collected first, and moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer to fix a missing-font crash on newer Android.
Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9, corrects Apple platform TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps), and fixes SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch.
Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.
Adds Linux Bionic native asset support and x64/arm64 Tizen native builds.
Updates expat, freetype, zlib, libpng, libjpeg-turbo and libexpat to their latest patched versions, and updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Variable font support, the singleton lifecycle rework, animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), color font palettes, and the SKPath finalizer fix
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native asset support and the PolySharp-based C# 13 build for legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Shrank the SkiaFiddle WASM gallery sample size by ~60%
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Updated the Uno Platform link and description in the README
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Opened the v4 line: bumped Skia to milestone 147, added variable font support and SKSamplingOptions surface/canvas draw overloads, upgraded SkiaSharp's major version from 3.x to 4.x, and refreshed several native dependencies.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Added animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData(), fixed the SKPath finalizer crash, and corrected Apple platform TFMs.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Added the HBColor struct and further HarfBuzz API wrappers, enabled TreatWarningsAsErrors across the binding, and updated HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Reworked the singleton lifecycle, promoted the remaining legacy paint/font APIs to compile errors, fixed the GetPixelSpan stride/offset bugs, and bumped to Skia m148 ahead of the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Bundles HarfBuzz 14.2.0, adding the HBColor struct for hb_color_t interop, full variable font shaping support, and several API wrapper and naming-convention fixes.
